title: Grade 7 French — Wed, Jun 11
description: Le passé composé — Day 3 of 5: Past participles of irregular verbs
subject: french

questions.question: Many common verbs have IRREGULAR past participles. What is the past participle of 'être' (to be)?
questions.explanation: Être → past participle 'été'. 'J'ai été malade.' = I was sick (lit. I have been sick).

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'avoir' (to have)?
questions.explanation: Avoir → past participle 'eu'. 'J'ai eu un cadeau.' = I got/received a gift (lit. I have had a gift).

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'faire' (to do/make)?
questions.explanation: Faire → past participle 'fait'. 'J'ai fait mes devoirs.' = I did my homework.

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'prendre' (to take)?
questions.explanation: Prendre → past participle 'pris'. 'J'ai pris le bus.' = I took the bus.

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'voir' (to see)?
questions.explanation: Voir → past participle 'vu'. 'J'ai vu un film hier.' = I saw a film yesterday.

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'lire' (to read)?
questions.explanation: Lire → past participle 'lu'. 'J'ai lu un livre intéressant.' = I read an interesting book.

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'écrire' (to write)?
questions.explanation: Écrire → past participle 'écrit'. 'J'ai écrit une lettre.' = I wrote a letter.

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'boire' (to drink)?
questions.explanation: Boire → past participle 'bu'. 'J'ai bu du thé ce matin.' = I drank tea this morning.

questions.question: Translate: 'She saw a beautiful film.'
options: Elle a vu un beau film.
Elle va voir un beau film.
questions.explanation: 'Elle a vu un beau film.' = She saw a beautiful film. Voir → vu. Passé composé: avoir + past participle.

questions.question: Translate: 'We did our homework.'
questions.explanation: 'Nous avons fait nos devoirs.' = We did our homework. Faire → fait. 'Avons' = nous form of avoir.

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'mettre' (to put/place)?
questions.explanation: Mettre → past participle 'mis'. 'J'ai mis mon manteau.' = I put on my coat.

questions.question: Translate: 'I took the train to Paris.'
options: J'ai pris le train pour Paris.
J'ai prendé le train pour Paris.
J'ai pris le train à Paris.
Je prends le train pour Paris.
questions.explanation: 'J'ai pris le train pour Paris.' = I took the train to Paris. Prendre → pris. 'Pour Paris' = to Paris (destination).

questions.question: Identify the error: 'J'ai lu un livre et j'ai écrivé une lettre.'
questions.explanation: 'Écrivé' is wrong — the past participle of écrire is 'écrit'. Correct: 'J'ai lu un livre et j'ai écrit une lettre.' = I read a book and I wrote a letter.

questions.question: Match: boire → ___ / lire → ___ / voir → ___
questions.explanation: boire → bu; lire → lu; voir → vu. These three-letter past participles (bu, lu, vu) are easy to remember as a group.

questions.question: Write in passé composé: 'Yesterday I (saw a film, read a book, drank a coffee).'
options: Hier, j'ai vu un film, j'ai lu un livre et j'ai bu un café.
Hier, je vois un film, je lis un livre et je bois un café.
Hier, j'avais vu un film, j'avais lu et bu.
Hier, je voyais un film, lisais un livre et buvais du café.
questions.explanation: 'Hier, j'ai vu un film, j'ai lu un livre et j'ai bu un café.' = Yesterday I saw a film, read a book and drank a coffee. All three use avoir + irregular past participle.
